name: Dremulae
description: Dremulae was a terrestrial planet in the Deep Core and was known for the natural beauty of its Sea of Translucency and for its popular wealthy resort.
lead_paragraphs: Dremulae was a terrestrial planet in the Deep Core and was known for the natural beauty of its Sea of Translucency and for its popular wealthy resort.
Dremulae was a popular galactic tourist attraction, even for those luxury travelers opting for a holographic simulation experience—a sim-vacation, or sim-voyage.
The Dreamul'er plant, which could heal a lightsaber cut, was native to Dremulae.
